body: سیدسهیل عزیز، 1,000,000,000 ریال به حساب شما نشست.
cases.why: Real message. There is no مبلغ label anywhere to hang the amount on, the direction comes from Blu's own «نشست», and the balance word is موجودی rather than مانده.

body: سیدسهیل عزیز، 25,000,000 ریال از حساب شما پرید.
cases.why: Blu's own phrasing for money leaving is «پرید», which no other bank writes.

body: سیدسهیل عزیز، 500,000,000 ریال از حساب شما پرید.
cases.why: The message says «انتقال پل» — a typo for پول, and not «انتقال وجه» either. The direction has to come from «از حساب شما پرید» instead. The single leading space on the two middle lines is real and is kept.

body: سیدسهیل عزیز، 1,000,000,000 ریال به حساب شما نشست.
cases.why: Real message, and the same body as blu-deposit-neshast under a different heading: «دریافت پل» matches no direction word, where «واریز پول» matched one on its first line. That leaves «نشست», which Blu writes *after* the amount — so a forward-only search walked past the amount, crossed «موجودی» and reported the balance as the sum received. The ledger showed +۱۶۵٫۱ میلیون for a message about ۱۰۰ میلیون.

body: سیدسهیل عزیز، 1,000,000 ریال از حساب شما پرید.
cases.why: Real notification from Blu's own app, read off a Pixel with the bank's alerts switched from SMS to push. Its title is «بلو» and its text is every other line of the SMS, word for word, so title and text joined by a newline are the message; the sender is the app's package, which is how the notification listener stores it.

body: فاطمه عزیز، در حال بررسی ویدیو انتقال مبلغ 5,000,000,000 ریال از حساب شما به حساب **** **** هستیم. برای پیگیری درخواست خود، روی لینک زیر بزنید.
cases.why: Real message; the stars are the recipient's name and the transaction id, redacted. Blu is still reviewing the transfer, so nothing has left the account yet — the debit arrives later as its own «پرید» message (blu-transfer-after-review). «انتقال مبلغ» read it as a spend, and the ledger showed the ۵۰۰ میلیون withdrawal twice.

body: فاطمه عزیز، 5,000,000,000ریال از حساب شما پرید.
cases.why: Real message: the debit that follows blu-transfer-under-review once the transfer goes through, and the one row the pair should make. «ریال» is glued to the figure.
